svg.text: TO FV-121 (FORCE CLOSED IN EQ STEPS)
O = OPEN, - = CLOSED, FIC = FV-121 ON FIC-121 (40 Nm3/h).
HALF CYCLE S1-S4 ~449 s AT DESIGN (NOTE 3).
* PURGE = FIC-121 SP WHILE PURGING; INTERNAL RECYCLE, NOT IN

1. DESIGN BASIS (TEXTBOOK EXAMPLE, ZEOLITE 5A O2 VPSA): AIR 1800 Nm3/h, 79/21 (Ar LUMPED WITH N2), 25 C; TEXTBOOK O2 234 Nm3/h AT 96 %; OTS DYNAMIC DESIGN: O2 191 Nm3/h AT 96 % (RECOVERY 48.6 %), N2-RICH 1608 Nm3/h, 88 % N2.
ALL PRESSURES bar a; Nm3 AT 0 C / 1.01325 bar. REAL AIR CARRIES 0.93 % Ar, WHICH 5A DOES NOT SEPARATE FROM O2: ACHIEVABLE PURITY <= 95.7 % O2 - 96 % IS THE OTS MODEL VALUE (TBC).
2. K-100: T2 = T1 (P2/P1)^((k-1)/k) / ETA: ONE STAGE 281 C / 166 kW, TWO STAGES INTERCOOLED 138 C / 147 kW (ETA 0.70) - STAGING, INTERCOOLER AND DISCHARGE T BY VENDOR (TBC).
E-100 DUTY ~86 kW INCL. ~19 kg/h CONDENSATE (AMBIENT 60 % RH ASSUMED, TBC) TO DT-104; RESIDUAL WATER (~9 kg/h AT 25 C, 5.15 bar a) IS TAKEN BY THE ACTIVATED-ALUMINA LAYER.

3. XV-111...114A/B: PNEUMATIC ON/OFF, FAIL CLOSED, SOLENOID, LIMIT SWITCHES ZSO/ZSC (NOT SHOWN); ALL DRIVEN BY KS-140, SIGNAL LINES NOT SHOWN INDIVIDUALLY. STEPS PER BED: PR, AD, EQ-D, BD, EV, EV+PG, EQ-R.
HALF CYCLE ~449 s AT DESIGN: S1 AD 209 s + S2 AD+PG 180 s (AD 389 s; AIC-124 TRIMS S1/S5, AD 330-530 s), S3 EQ 30 s, S4 BD/PR 30 s (OTS CYCLE SIMULATION).

4. PARTIAL EQUALISATION (30 s) ENDS AT ~3.3 / 0.85 bar a (DONOR / RECEIVER) > V-103 1.25 bar a, SO BLOWDOWN LEAVES THROUGH CV-130. XV-114A/B OPENING SPEED LIMITED (ADJUSTABLE STOPS, TBC). FV-121 FORCED CLOSED IN EQ STEPS.
IN S4/S8 BOTH XV-111 ARE CLOSED: FEED ACCUMULATES IN V-100 (~ +0.75 bar IN 30 s, BELOW PIC-103 6.2 bar a). K-101 RUNS ON CLOSED SUCTION (UNLOADING PER VENDOR, TBC).

5. PT-115A/B ROOT VALVES HV-159A/B SHOWN, LO (THEY FEED I-1); OTHER TRANSMITTERS c/w ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN). TE-116/117/118 = BED THERMOCOUPLES BOTTOM/MIDDLE/TOP, TRENDED AS TI ON THE DCS. PDT-119 TAPS ABOVE AND BELOW THE PACKING.
6. V-101A/B: 1910 mm ID, 5640 mm ZEOLITE 5A (12.8 t, 792 kg/m3) OVER 0.3 m ACTIVATED ALUMINA; DESIGN 7 bar a / FULL VACUUM (NO VACUUM RELIEF NEEDED). PSVs DISCHARGE TO A SAFE LOCATION.
VENTS AND DRAINS SHOWN (REV B); MANWAYS AND MEDIA FILL/DUMP NOZZLES NOT SHOWN (VENDOR). SUPERFICIAL VELOCITY IN AD ~0.04 m/s AT 4.7 bar a (UPFLOW LIFT CHECK BY VENDOR, TBC).
7. PIPING CLASSES: A1A CARBON STEEL 150#; O2S SS316L CLEANED FOR OXYGEN SERVICE (CGA G-4.1 / EIGA 33), VELOCITIES PER EIGA 13; C1A CARBON STEEL, FULL-VACUUM RATED. SIZES PRELIMINARY - TBC BY PIPING.
CHWS/CHWR = CHILLED WATER 10 C SUPPLY / RETURN (~15 m3/h AT dT 5 K). V-100 DRAINS TO OIL-FREE CONDENSATE DRAIN.
8. FIC-101 HOLDS THE FEED AIR AT 1800 Nm3/h (LOCAL SP); V-102 PRESSURE IS HELD BY PIC-123 > FIC-125. K-100 MIN. SPEED / UNLOAD PER VENDOR. INTERLOCKS I-1...I-6: SEE PSA-PID-002.

9. HAND VALVES (REV B) ARE NORMALLY OPEN UNLESS MARKED NC (NORMALLY CLOSED), LO (LOCKED / CAR-SEALED OPEN) OR LC (LOCKED CLOSED); LO VALVES ARE CLOSED ONLY UNDER PERMIT WITH THE UNIT STOPPED. HV-155A/B AND HV-156A/B ISOLATE A BED

FOR MAINTENANCE (ADD SPECTACLE BLINDS FOR ENTRY, TBC); CLOSING ONE WHILE CYCLING DEAD-ENDS THE BED (I-1). PSV-100 / PSV-110A/B HAVE NO BLOCK VALVES: TESTED AT SHUTDOWN. VENTS / DRAINS 1" c/w PLUG. HAND-VALVE LIST: OTS P&ID TAB.
HAND VALVES, VENTS AND DRAINS ADDED
